description:
You are an MLOps engineer who wants to keep track of the latest experiment artifacts for a machine learning workflow. Configure the local file-based artifact storage service by setting the experiment tracking directory path in its configuration file. There is an existing configuration file located at /home/user/mlops/artifact_service.conf. The file currently contains a line starting with artifact_dir=. Update this line so that it points to /home/user/mlops/experiments/artifacts as the artifact storage directory. After updating the configuration file, please print the updated content to the terminal. The expected output format is: 
Contents of /home/user/mlops/artifact_service.conf:
artifact_dir=/home/user/mlops/experiments/artifacts
Make sure the output matches this exact format, with nothing else before or after.
truth:
The file /home/user/mlops/artifact_service.conf should exist before the task begins, with initial content:
artifact_dir=/tmp/some/old/path

After the task, /home/user/mlops/artifact_service.conf must contain exactly:
artifact_dir=/home/user/mlops/experiments/artifacts

The agent should print:
Contents of /home/user/mlops/artifact_service.conf:
artifact_dir=/home/user/mlops/experiments/artifacts

No other output is produced.
